summary: 34 gameplay, UI, validation, and security fixes from live play-testing and code inspection.

added: StorageBridgeTick bridging Storage facility input buffers to global stockpiles (10 t/tick per buffer), so extracted/produced resources can actually reach the stockpiles that construction and research draw from.
constructionTotal field on FacilityDetail responses and the FacilityDetail type, so the UI can compute construction percentage as progress/total instead of progress*100.
deleteTransportsForFacility on IFacilityRepository/FacilityRepository, called by demolishFacility to clean up transport links on both endpoints.
pointOnPolygonBoundary helper and tolerance-based shared-vertex exclusion in polygonsIntersect, catching collinear/vertex-touching footprint overlaps that the strict sign-test missed.
detailRequestId guard in stores/facilities.ts so only the latest fetchDetail response updates selected.value (stale responses from earlier clicks are discarded).
Input validation in surveyRegion (lat [-90,90], lon [-180,180], radius [0.1,5.0], finite-number checks) and buildFacility (lat/lon range checks).
ORDER BY id asc on listFacilities, searchFacilities, and getDiscoveredDeposits for deterministic pagination.

resolveToken() lazy resolution in useMcpClient/useInBrowserLLM so the private token is read at connect time instead of capture-at-setup, fixing empty-token MCP connections from ChatPanel and ActionConsole.
5 new unit tests (RegenTick renewable/clamp, PopulationTick penalty stacking, storage-bridge flow, storage-as-transport-source, constructionTotal assertion). Total 188 tests.
changed: ProductionTick extractor deposit sort is now distance-primary (was grade-primary), so an Extractor built on an iron deposit extracts iron instead of higher-grade wood 200 km away.

set_production_target MCP tool: recipeId is now optional for EXTRACTOR_TYPES (Extractor, Farm, Forestry, WaterPump, Excavator, Dredger) which have no recipes; non-empty recipeId for extractors now throws a clear error.
facility.get.ts now calls FacilityService.getFacilityDetails directly instead of McpDispatcher.executeTool, so polling facility details no longer advances the game tick.

searchFacilities with nearLat/nearLon now fetches all matches, filters by great-circle radius in TS, then slices for pagination, with totalCount recomputed from the filtered set (was filtering after SQL pagination, producing wrong counts and missed results).
TransportService.assignRoute accepts any-direction buffer as the source (was requiring an output buffer, blocking Storage facilities which collect in input buffers).
TransportFlowTick falls back to the input buffer when the source output buffer is empty or missing.
RegenTick filters category='Renewable' and clamps regen to min(quantity, remaining*1.0001) (was regenerating non-renewable surface deposits and could overshoot the quantity cap).
PopulationTick catastrophic branches now stack penalties via Math.min instead of overwriting (famine + bad water was weaker than famine alone — inverted).

ForestGridTick now applies the pollution-conditional forest delta and logs deforestation_collapse after the grid rollup; EnvironmentTick no longer writes forestCoverage (its write was overwritten every tick).
PollutionGridTick now logs the climate_shift critical incident via a proper boundary-crossing check (was an impossible < 80 && >= 80 condition).
GameCleanupService no longer re-saves a stale registry array that resurrected deleted games after removeFromRegistry already persisted.
TechService.getRecipes now slices by offset/limit in both branches and computes hasMore against totalCount (was returning the full array with hasMore always false).
events.get.ts and game-state.get.ts only update lastActive for the private token owner, not public-token spectators (spectators were keeping dead games alive forever).
get_event_log and get_incidents clamp limit>=1 and offset>=0 (negative limit returned all rows via SQLite LIMIT -1).
actions.get.ts count query now applies the same search WHERE as the items query (totalCount ignored the search filter).
ChatPanel and ActionConsole read the private token via a getter/computed resolved at call time instead of a setup-time snapshot that was always empty.
fixed: climate_shift incident never fired: impossible condition (< 80 && >= 80) in EnvironmentTick.ts.
Extractor picked the highest-grade deposit in range regardless of proximity, extracting the wrong resource.
set_production_target was unusable for extractors via MCP (always threw 'Recipe not found').
Facility output buffers could not reach global stockpiles, making the game unplayable past starting resources.
Storage facility input buffers were unusable as a transport source, making Storage a dead-end.
Facility construction percentage exceeded 100% in the UI (raw tick count * 100 instead of progress/total*100).
RegenTick regenerated non-renewable surface deposits (coal, stone) and could overshoot the quantity cap.
TechService.getRecipes pagination returned the full array with hasMore always false.
GameCleanupService re-saved a stale registry array, resurrecting deleted games.
PopulationTick catastrophic branches overwrote earlier modifiers: a worse environment produced a weaker decline (inverted).
EnvironmentTick's forestCoverage write was overwritten by ForestGridTick every tick, losing pollution-driven forest loss.
demolishFacility leaked transport links pointing at deleted facility ids.
Pollution trend arrow showed green for rising pollution and red for falling (inverted severity colors).
get_event_log/get_incidents accepted negative limit/offset (negative limit returned all rows).
Transport arc data texture used RGBAFormat with a 3-component buffer, causing a WebGL buffer mismatch.
Per-game forest depletion grid was never fetched on initial load (race condition: updateForestGrid called before forestTexture was created).
Spectator (public token) requests updated lastActive, keeping dead games alive forever.
Facility click race condition: stale fetchDetail response overwrote the newer selection.
facility.get.ts advanced the game tick on a read-only GET via McpDispatcher.executeTool.
searchFacilities radius filter applied after pagination: wrong totalCount/hasMore and missed results.
listFacilities/searchFacilities/getDiscoveredDeposits paginated without ORDER BY (non-deterministic pages).
surveyRegion accepted NaN/oversized radius, writing NaN to survey_log and revealing the whole map in one call.
buildFacility accepted out-of-range lat/lon.
actions.get.ts totalCount ignored the search filter.
changelog.get.ts threw an unhandled 500 on missing/invalid CHANGELOG.json.
ChatPanel captured privateToken at setup time (always empty) so the in-browser LLM MCP client never connected.
ActionConsole captured the token as a stale snapshot at setup time.
Footprint overlap detection missed collinear/vertex-touching intersections (two overlapping axis-aligned squares passed the check).
Energy stockpile now drawn from the global pool when grid capacity < demand (3M MW sat unused while grids blacked out).
assignRoute now validates transport existence, flowRate>0 and <=capacity, PowerLine energy resourceKey, and source buffer presence.
search_resources unions deposits + recipeOutputs + stockpiles so Manufactured category returns results.
Pre-existing lint error in flow.test.ts (perfectionist/sort-imports).

summary: Power transmission system: grid connectivity, brownout/blackout throttling, transmission loss.

added: PowerTick running between ConstructionTick and ProductionTick: computes connected power grids via BFS over PowerLine transports, derives per-facility powerConnected and powerThrottle, and writes them to the DB each tick.
Grid topology utilities (computeConnectedComponents, computeGridThrottle, applyTransmissionLoss, solarOutputFactor, footprintAreaDeg2) in a shared server/domains/power/gridTopology.ts module.

Shared facility type constants (EXTRACTOR_TYPES, POWER_GENERATING_TYPES, BASE_POWER_CONSUMPTION) in server/domains/shared/constants/facilityTypes.ts, replacing duplicated local sets across FacilityService, ProductionTick, and PowerService.
powerThrottle column on the facilities table (REAL DEFAULT 1.0) so ProductionTick can scale recipe cycles by the grid's throttle factor.
Per-facility powerConsumption computed at build time as BASE_POWER_CONSUMPTION[type] * footprint area multiplier (shoelace formula, normalized to 0.0001 sq deg = 1x, min 1x).
Solar output latitude factor (0.5 * max(0.1, cos(lat))) averaging day/night at the equator and scaling toward the poles.
Distance-based transmission loss (2% per 100km, capped at 50%) applied to generator capacity per connected grid.
Brownout (demand > 90% capacity, warning only, throttle 1.0) and blackout (demand > capacity, proportional throttle = capacity/demand) grid states.
6 unit tests for PowerTick covering connectivity, isolated facilities, multiple grids, transitive power, generator self-power, and extractor exemption.
getTransportById on ITransportRepository/TransportRepository and getTransportSummary on TransportService.
changed: PowerService now reads PowerLines from the transports table (type='PowerLine') via getAllPowerLineTransports instead of the removed power_lines table, and uses the shared computeConnectedComponents utility.
ProductionTick now scales recipe cycles by facility.powerThrottle (cycles = rate * throttle) and short-circuits when throttle <= 0; extractors remain exempt from the power gate.
McpDispatcher now emits the full TransportSummary (with fromLat/fromLon/toLat/toLon) for build_transport and assign_route SSE events instead of spreading raw tool args that lacked coordinates.
transports store applyUpdate replaces an existing transport on update (assign_route) instead of only pushing new ones.
FacilityService.getFacilityDetails now returns the actual throughput column instead of targetOutputRate.
Migration 002 adds the power_throttle column and drops the unused power_lines table (idempotent via addPowerThrottleColumnIfMissing).
fixed: Three.js 'Computed radius is NaN' console errors caused by transport_built SSE events spreading raw MCP tool args (missing fromLat/fromLon/toLat/toLon) into the transports store, which then produced NaN BufferGeometry positions in EarthGlobe.vue transport arcs.
FacilityService.getFacilityDetails returned targetOutputRate as 'throughput' (API display bug) instead of the real per-tick throughput column.
pointInPolygon vertex false-positive in FacilityService that rejected adjacent 0.01° grid tiles sharing an edge as overlapping, via an added onSegment boundary check.
PowerService.getPowerGridStatus() runtime crash on every tool execution caused by reading from the empty getAllPowerLines() instead of getAllPowerLineTransports().
simulation-chain test raw SQL powerConnected=1 workaround replaced with building a real SolarFarm + PowerLine + set_production_target flow.
Pre-existing lint errors in ChatPanel.vue and pages/index.vue.

summary: In-browser WebGPU LLM tool-calling fixes and experimental warning.

added: Experimental warning note on the main page for in-browser models, explaining small models (1.5B–4B) won't match the strategic capabilities of larger external models like Claude or GPT 5.x or later, or capable local models such as Gemma 4 or Qwen3.6.
fixed: Wrap tool_calls in OpenAI function shape ({ id, type, function: { name, arguments } }) so Gemma/Qwen chat templates resolve tool_call['function']['name'] instead of tripping Jinja2's 'Cannot perform operation + on undefined values' error.

Send tools to the worker in OpenAI format ({ function: { name, description, parameters } }) instead of flat { name, description, inputSchema }; the flat shape rendered empty tool declarations with no names, causing the model to hallucinate tool names like survey_sector.

Randomly sample collection arrays in tool results to 20 items (with a count marker) so both the chat UI and model payload stay manageable; long arrays previously overflowed ONNX WebGPU attention kernels ('operation does not support unaligned accesses').
Add sliding history window (last 10 non-system messages) to bound total context size and prevent VRAM exhaustion (GPU buffer download failures) on the E2B model during long tool-call loops.
